verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a cloud phone and contact-center platform, but nothing in the evidence shows Aircall can be deployed on a customer's own infrastructure. The closest item, importing recordings and voicemail into your own infrastructure (aircall-docs-8), is a data-export feature, not self-hosting of the core product, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
